tags.name: Auth
tags.description: Better Auth at `/api/auth/*`. POSTs expect **Content-Type: application/json** (use `{}` for sign-out). Email: `/sign-in/email`, `/sign-up/email`, `/request-password-reset`, `/reset-password`, `/change-password`. Session: **GET /get-session** (not `/session`). OAuth: **POST /sign-in/social** then provider hits **GET /callback/{provider}**. Uses **session** cookie.
